notes.title: Montlhy update
notes.notes:
Development Montlhy update

Hi to all  Horse lovers  ,*** I want to extend my sincerest apologies for my absence from my steam community 🥺 . I truly appreciate your patience and understanding during this time.
I want to assure you that I am committed to being more active and communicative moving forward. It's important to me that you're kept in the loop about the progress of our game and the exciting developments ahead.🥳 🥳 

In terms of game development, I'm thrilled to share some updates from this month's progress:

1.   Shop System Completion🛍️ : I'm happy to report that I've successfully finished developing the shop system. This will add an immersive layer to our game, who doesn’t like to spend money?
2.    Quest System Remake:❓  I've identified the need for improvements in the quest system. I'm currently working on a complete overhaul to ensure that quests are engaging, intuitive, and seamlessly integrated into the gameplay.
3.    Pixel Art Assets and Controls: 🎨 A significant portion of my time is dedicated to refining the pixel art assets and fine-tuning the controls. This will enhance the visual appeal and playability of our game.
4.  Sounds and Music Integration: I'm also working diligently on adding sounds and music to create a fully immersive experience for all players. This will bring our game world to life in a whole new way.

⏭️ ⏭️ Looking ahead, here's what's on the horizon:⏭️ ⏭️ ⏭️ ⏭️ 

1.    **Art Dialogues and Lore**: These elements are pivotal in establishing the rich narrative of my game. Expect engaging dialogues and a well-crafted lore that will captivate players and draw them deeper into our world.
2.    **Show Jumping Competitions:** I'll be diving into creating assets and fine-tuning the balance of difficulties and rewards for these exciting horse competitions.


While I'm working full-time,⏲️  I'm dedicating every free moment I have to the development of Rising Star The Horse Game 🐴 . Please understand that creating a game of this caliber takes time, but I'm fully committed to delivering a polished experience that you'll all love.
Thank you for your unwavering support and enthusiasm. Your feedback and encouragement drive me to push the boundaries of what we can achieve together.💪 
Looking forward to sharing more updates soon.
